spans.s: (probably onomat.; but cf. Uṇ. iii, 43) a frog, Up.; Kāv. &c. (accord. to Kathās. xx, 77 the croaking of frogs was caused by the curse of Agni who was betrayed by them to the gods when he took refuge in the water)
a timid man (= भीरु), L. (cf. भेल)
N. of a Niṣāda and a Brāhmaṇī, L.
a female frog, L. Hydrocotyle Asiatica, L.
भेक—पर्णी f. ‘frog-leaved’, a species of plant, L.
भेक—शब्द m. the croaking of frogs, Cat.
N. of a class of Apsaras, VS.; VP. (cf. बाकुर and भाकुरि).
